integrity: All theorem statements are supported by an analytic scalar proof. Finite decimal verification is corroborative only. No publication priority beyond inspected sources or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed confidence parameter strictly between one and four; asymptotic sufficiently-large steepness without an optimal explicit threshold; one continuous persuadable opinion and two symmetric fixed zealots; no extension to higher-dimensional, asymmetric or stochastic dynamics.
title: Five equilibrium branches and sharp basin separators for a three-agent sigmoidal confidence model
